## Summary / 修改说明

Describe what changes for users and how it affects the scientific results.
说明用户可见的变化，以及是否影响科学计算结果。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] `ruff check src tests tools scripts`
- [ ] `python scripts/run_coverage.py`
- [ ] Numerical reference comparisons updated where needed / 按需更新数值参考比较
- [ ] Performance results state hardware and timed steps / 性能结果注明硬件和计时范围

## Data and attribution / 数据与来源

- [ ] No human MRI, subject identifiers, credentials, private paths, or generated subject outputs / 不包含人体 MRI、被试标识、凭据、私有路径或被试结果
- [ ] Copied or adapted material has its origin and license recorded / 复制或改编的材料注明来源与许可

## Scientific changes / 科学计算变化

State any changes to resolution, iterations, stopping conditions, tensor order,
coordinate transforms, floating-point calculations, or error handling.
说明分辨率、迭代次数、停止条件、张量顺序、坐标变换、浮点计算或错误处理是否改变。
